tooltip.circle_of_inevitability.sun_broo: Right-click: purification (6 blocks), cleanse poison/wither, night vision. Cooldown: 8s.
Carrying builds heat; each use adds 20. At 60: weakness and exhaustion; at 100: slowness.
Water/rain cools it. Store it outside your inventory to recover. Multiple copies share heat/cooldown.
